'''Chils Melpin''' was the [[Prex]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. After [[Auditor-General]]s [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] and [[Naven Crel]] learned that he had been selling CSA secrets to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he dispatched his assistant, [[Akeeli Somerce]], to eliminate both of them discreetly. However, Somerce failed to complete her task, leaving Fiolla alive. Fiolla would later vow to bring Meplin down for his corruption and role in the murder of Naven Crel.
